name: W&B Weave
summary: Weave is the tracing and evaluation toolkit from Weights & Biases, now part of CoreWeave. It captures agent sessions, LLM calls and tool calls, versions traced functions, and scores outputs with LLM judges or custom scorers. Accounts now run through CoreWeave Forge, and CoreWeave's docs describe its new Agent Lens product as Weave's successor.
facts: Accepts OTLP spans without the SDK
Free tier (1 GB/mo ingestion); Pro from $60/mo
goodFor: Teams already using W&B for model training
watchOut: Being succeeded by CoreWeave Agent Lens
Branding and accounts moving to CoreWeave Forge
